scenarios.name: Collapse and expands a feature branch

scenario_steps.name: an active part in the MCAD Software contains a visible block made by an extrusion with a nested sketch
the extrusion branch is expanded in the model browser
the user clicks the extrusion branch expansion control
the sketch row is hidden and the extrusion row remains visible
the block remains visible in the same apparent view
the user clicks the extrusion branch expansion control again
the sketch row appears beneath the extrusion
the block remains visible in the same apparent view
